recalculation.notes: The primary-source EOS audit is complete, but the accessible evidence did not identify an exact pressure-calibration equation unambiguously enough to encode it.

pressure_calibration.notes: No reference EOS is inferred from experimental apparatus, pressure medium, author, or publication era.

assessment.basis: Every compared free coefficient meets both the recorded combined-two-sigma comparison and parameter-specific numerical similarity screen. Error conventions and fit qualifications remain applicable.

primary_source_check.finding: The source reports rho0=6.14(20) Mg/m^3 and K0=160(19) GPa with K0'=4. Peritheos converts rho0 and its uncertainty to the one-formula-unit B2 conventional-cell volume; no covariance is published.

primary_data_check.finding: The material record already links the source dataset resource(s) listed here; this audit makes that primary-data coverage explicit.

parameter_provenance.determination_method: Measurements or their experimental reduction determine this EOS; source: page 11774, Table 1, B2-SrO density observations; pages 11775-11776, equations (1)-(7), finite-strain derivation; page 11776, second-order fit and Figure 3.
parameter_provenance.V0: Sato and Jeanloz (1981), page 11776: rho0=6.14+/-0.20 Mg/m^3, converted to the Z=1 Pm-3m conventional-cell volume
parameter_provenance.K0: Sato and Jeanloz (1981), page 11776, second-order fit
parameter_provenance.equation: Sato and Jeanloz (1981), equations (1)-(7) and page 11776: second-order Eulerian finite strain with K0'=4

superseded_record_text.notes: Room-temperature second-order finite-strain EOS for B2 SrO. The published rho0=6.14+/-0.20 Mg/m^3 converts to V0=28.0224+/-0.9128 A^3 for one SrO per Pm-3m cell; K0=160+/-19 GPa and K0'=4 fixed. B2 reflections were measured from 32 to 59 GPa, with B1-B2 coexistence at 32 and 37 GPa and a transition pressure of 36+/-4 GPa. No covariance is published.
